newsitem.title: FRANCE: France breaks up ring smuggling Chinese to France.
newsitem.headline: France breaks up ring smuggling Chinese to France.

text.p: French authorities said on Wednesday they had broken up, for the second time in a month, a criminal ring running illegal immigrants into France from China.

An Interior Ministry statement said 53 people were detained when the ring, run by what was called "a mafia-like Chinese organisation", was broken up last month. No reason was given for the delay in making the operation public.
Several of those held will face charges of theft and extortion, said the authorities.
The ring allegedly charged 100,000 francs ($17,000) for each illegal immigrant.
The would-be immigrants flew from China to Moscow and were transferred to Prague, where Vietnamese nationals escorted them into Germany on foot before driving them into France, officials said.
Some went on to Spain and Italy while those who stayed in France were employed in clandestine clothing factories, officials said.
Police last month said they had arrested 20 people in a crackdown on a second ring also smuggling immigrants from China and which was holding two immigrants for ransom.
Authorities said they are particularly worried by Chinese gangs which smuggle in immigrants and now appear to be tempted to branch out into other criminal activities on French soil.
